sourceDataset.scope: Same BigBrain specimen; six layers per side; deep-learning-supported published delineation, not a new manual expert review of this application

rationale: The same-specimen published six-layer LGN source is aligned to native100 cytoarchitectonic profiles on three axes. Official-transformed centre locations and full app500 voxel mask were independently returned to native space and visually checked. Layer gaps are preserved. One app cell [240,209,138] previously classified as right thalamus lies at the dorsal LGN profile identified by the higher-resolution layer provider; source-specific LGN identity is preferred for this single cell. The 0.5 mm cell boundary remains an approximation, not new expert histology.
limitation: Published deep-learning-supported layer union, resampled to 0.5 mm; not all voxels manually expert drawn. This project transformation/adoption is AI-reviewed only. Does not identify optic tracts or radiations.

before.method: marching cubes 0.5; no smoothing, resampling, filling or component removal
before.scope: section-view BigBrain selection/context only; not expert validation
